outcome: resolution of the second labor stage
cohort: The study included 100 athletic women experiencing complications during the abnormal second stage of labor between February 2021 and February 2022.
finding: Forceps delivery in athletic women experiencing an abnormal second stage of labor was associated with a shorter duration to delivery, reduced bleeding, improved maternal and neonatal outcomes, higher maternal satisfaction, and a faster return to training compared to emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery demonstrated significant advantages over emergency cesarean section for athletic women with abnormal second-stage labor, leading to quicker recovery and better outcomes for both mother and child.
